maya: Heads-up: All-hands Monday 10:00 PT (25m). Short agenda + Q&A doc. Add questions here or in the doc.

maya: Agenda (25m):
- 10:00-10:05 Exec pulse: priorities + hiring ask
- 10:05-10:12 Roadmap highlight: routing + cost controls
- 10:12-10:18 Policy update: default retention & postmortem publishing
- 10:18-10:25 Q&A (top upvoted)

ashwin: Roadmap note: rolling out per-route budget enforcement in beta this sprint; will demo basic config.

jon: Ops update: small runbook change 1: add healthcheck preflight and auto-escalate to oncall lead after 3 failed attempts. Pasted diff in the doc.

srini: Policy: default debug retention will move to 90 days; projects can opt out in Project Settings. Migration checklist added to the Q&A doc.

kate: APAC folks: slides & recording posted after the meeting; office hour 16:00 SGT for region follow-ups.

all-hands-bot: Calendar event created: All-hands  Fall Roadmap & Policy sync  Monday 10:00 PT.

recording-bot: Recording link (uploaded after meeting): https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1912345678-fall-roadmap.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1912345678)

maya: Post-meeting takeaways:
- Exec: reiterated reliability-first; approved +3 infra hires.
- Roadmap: per-route budgets beta; demo showed ~8-12% lower spend on test workloads.
- Policy: default retention -> 90 days; opt-out documented; postmortem publishing enabled for Sev2+.

maya: If we missed any Qs in the doc, we'll reply in-thread and add to the notes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
